dossier.scp_unleashed.z0001.title: The Black Book
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0001.caption: Z-0001 as delivered, photographed on a light table.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: Z-0001 is not held at any Foundation site. It is supplied through the facility network on request, and responsibility for it passes to whoever makes the request. %rNo department has claimed the listing.%r
Z-0001 is to be kept closed when not under observation. It is not to be left where unsupervised personnel can reach it, and it is never to be stored in the same room as a staff roster.
**Personnel are not to write in Z-0001.**

page.title: Description:
text: Z-0001 is a hardbound book about the size of a field notebook, bound in black leather with no title, author or maker's mark. A small diamond is pressed into the front cover. It matches no known seal.
Z-0001 opens to a single ruled page. Turning past it returns the reader to the same page. The paper is old and foxed at the edges, and it has never been seen to wear any further.

The book does not burn, and blasts that level the room around it leave it unmarked. Staff who handle it for long report a faint warmth in the cover, like the warmth of a hand that has only just let go.

page.title: Addendum Z-0001-1: Test Log
text: Test Z-01: a researcher wrote the word "creeper". The ink stayed wet for a few seconds, then faded from the page.
Test Z-02: a D-Class subject was asked to write his own name. He refused, and could not say why.
Test Z-03: a name was copied from an old personnel file. The ink would not take. The person named had left the site the year before.
Test Z-04: %rExpunged.%r Testing suspended by order of the Site Director.

page.title: Addendum Z-0001-2: Provenance
page.text: Z-0001 has no recovery record. It appeared in the facility network's supply listings without an entry from any department, and it cannot be removed from them.

page.title: Addendum Z-0001-3: Note
page.text: A bell is sometimes heard on site where no bell exists. Recordings of it come back silent. %rEvery recorded instance followed a test.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0001_book.1: Z-0001 is a Z-Class object. Z-Class objects never turn up in the archive. This one can only be bought through the Shop app on a facility computer, and it arrives with its file.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0001_book.2: Open it to find a lined page. What the page accepts, it keeps until morning. What it refuses, it lets fade.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0001_book.3: Be careful what you write in it.
